title: ScholarFlow structure preset
description: Contract for one structure preset resource. Built-ins ship in presets/structures/<paperType>/<id>.json; user copies live under <DSH_HOME>/scholarflow/presets/user/. The loading directory decides `source`, never this document.

schemaVersion.description: Higher versions are read-only; never guess a meaning for them.

id.description: Must equal the file name. Stable once created; rename only changes the title.

order.description: Ascending display order inside one paper type; the lowest value is that type's default. Required and unique for built-ins.

whenToUse.description: One entry per situation, carrying both languages together so the counts cannot drift. Built-ins provide 2-4.

key.description: Stable and unique inside this preset; used to compare against the paper's snapshot.

share.description: Body share. Stored normalised: the section shares sum to 1 within 1e-6.

shareSource.description: Widening this to 'sourced' requires a contract update (SPEC v1.1 §5.1).

leadShare.description: Share of this chapter spent on a lead-in before the first subsection. With subsections present, leadShare plus the subsection shares must sum to 1 within 1e-6.

subsections.description: One level of nested sections. Their shares are normalised inside this chapter, never across the preset.

supplementalParts.description: Abstract, keywords, references, appendix, publication details, acknowledgements and the declared cover/table of contents. These never take a share of the body target.

methodNotes.description: Conditional method hints. Not a record that any method was carried out.

references.description: Where the structure comes from. Required for built-ins.

derivedFrom.description: User copies only. A derived entry keeps its own id and never overwrites the source.

tags.description: Free text for searching. User entries only; built-ins keep the controlled paperType.

localizedText.description: A plain string, or a Chinese entry with an optional English one. Built-ins carry both; user entries may carry one and are shown literally.

key.description: Stable and unique inside its chapter; also distinct from the chapter's own key.

share.description: Share inside the chapter. Stored normalised: leadShare plus the subsection shares sum to 1 within 1e-6.
